messages.text: I'm at the store. Do we still have eggs?
Only two left. Can you also grab milk? Oh, and my sister is staying over tonight.
Got it. Should I get something for dinner, then?
Don't worry, I'm making pasta. Just maybe some extra bread.

questions.stem: What does Jordan offer to do?
options: C. Return the eggs to the store
questions.explanation: Jordan asks, "Should I get something for dinner, then?"

questions.stem: At 5:46 P.M., why does Sam most likely ask for extra bread?
options: A. Because there will be an additional person at dinner
B. Because the store has run out of pasta
C. Because Jordan forgot to buy milk
D. Because Sam's sister is bringing eggs
questions.explanation: Sam mentions that "my sister is staying over tonight," so more food will be needed for one more person.
